story/tencents-ai-office-standard-releas.headline: What the Tencent-backed AI office standard covers
story/tencents-ai-office-standard-releas.deck: The Shenzhen framework sets out how office AI should protect data, record actions in audit trails and make clear who is accountable.

story/aviation-ai-moves-toward-automated.headline: How AI agents could handle airline bookings and servicing
story/aviation-ai-moves-toward-automated.deck: CAPA examines what AI agents could do across flight search, booking and servicing, and where airlines would still need human oversight.

story/engineers-will-shape-ais-real-worl.headline: What engineers need to test before AI acts in the real world
story/engineers-will-shape-ais-real-worl.deck: A La Presse opinion piece explains why AI for factories and aviation needs safeguards, including tests for failures and unexpected conditions.

research/when-should-llms-abstain-chain-.headline: When should AI say it does not know?
research/when-should-llms-abstain-chain-.deck: In an 817-question benchmark, prompting language models to abstain when uncertain reduced wrong answers and left some questions unanswered.

story/french-author-questions-ais-abilit.headline: Can AI capture a writer’s personal voice?
story/french-author-questions-ais-abilit.deck: A Le Devoir essay asks what AI imitation misses about how a writer’s voice develops through lived experience, language and culture.
